svg.aria-label: Lumbopelvic rhythm in forward bending — 前屈时的腰椎-骨盆节律

text.aria-label: Lumbopelvic rhythm in forward bending — 前屈时的腰椎-骨盆节律
text.tspan: 前屈时的腰椎-骨盆节律

text.aria-label: Hip flexion (anterior pelvic tilt on the femoral heads) — 屈髋（骨盆在股骨头上前倾）
text.tspan: Hip flexion (anterior pelvic tilt on the femoral heads)
屈髋（骨盆在股骨头上前倾）

text.aria-label: Upright start position — 直立起始姿势
Thick = leading part — 粗线 = 主导部分
Lumbar flexion leads — 腰椎主导

svg.text: Early forward bending: lumbar flexion leads
前屈早期：腰椎屈曲为主
Motion starts at the lumbosacral spine;
lumbar-to-pelvic ratio > 1.
动作从腰骶部开始；腰椎/骨盆比值 > 1。

text.aria-label: Both share the motion — 两者共同参与

svg.text: Mid range: anterior pelvic tilt joins in
中段：骨盆前倾加入
The pelvis tilts forward on the femoral heads; the
ratio falls. Lumbar and hip extensors (hamstrings,
gluteus maximus) lower the trunk eccentrically.
骨盆在股骨头上前倾，比值下降；腰伸肌和伸髋肌（腘绳
肌、臀大肌）离心控制躯干下降。

text.aria-label: Hip flexion dominates — 屈髋主导

svg.text: End range: hip flexion dominates
末段：屈髋为主
Most motion comes from the pelvis and hips; ratio < 1
(about 0.5 in one study). Tight hamstrings limit this
phase.
运动主要来自骨盆和髋；比值 < 1（一项研究约 0.5）。腘
绳肌紧张会限制这一阶段。

text.aria-label: Hips first, then lumbar spine — 先髋后腰

svg.text: Return to upright: hips first, then lumbar spine
回到直立：先髋后腰
① Hip extensors tilt the pelvis back first; ② lumbar
extension follows near the end.
① 伸髋肌先使骨盆后倾；② 接近结束时腰椎才伸展。

text.tspan: Schematic; pathway and layers are simplified.
解剖示意；走行与层次经过简化。
